# Script bodies the pipefail grep -q scanner must red on, one per block; a line
# holding only %% ends a block. Each is planted as a script that sets pipefail.
printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- "^--- PASS: TestX "
%%
go test -v ./... 2>&1 | grep -qF 'ok  '
%%
if ! scutil --dns | awk '{print $1}' | grep -Eq "^nameserver"; then :; fi
%%
seen() { newlog | command grep -qx "$1"; }
%%
kc get pods -o name |
	grep -q pod/x
%%
kc get pods -o name \
	| grep --quiet pod/x
%%
echo "$x" | fgrep -qs y && echo yes
%%
cat <<'BODY'
ifconfig lo0 | grep -q "inet 10."
BODY
%%
! find . -name x | grep -q .
%%
out="$(on peer "ifconfig bridge0 | grep -q member && echo up")"
